app.title: Nvidia Kubernetes Engine (NVKE)
app.author: gkapur
app.description: A lightweight, open-source Kubernetes distribution designed for developers and small workloads, featuring automatic cluster provisioning and simplified management.
proposed_tests: git clone the repo and run `make install` to set up NVKE locally
start a single-node cluster and verify the API server is reachable at https://127.0.0.1:6443
deploy a sample nginx pod and confirm it serves traffic via `kubectl get pods` and `curl`
measure cluster start time and compare to Kind
run `nvke version` to ensure the CLI reports the correct version
